message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 in Europeans**

| Population | Allele | Frequency (AF) |
|------------|--------|----------------|
| Non‑Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **C** | **≈ 0.12 (12 %)** |
| Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **C** | **≈ 0.10 (10 %)** |

*The C allele at rs7412 is the minor allele that, together with rs429358, defines the APOE ε2 allele.  In most continental European populations the ε2 allele frequency is roughly 8–12 %, which corresponds to the C allele frequency shown above.*

**Sources**

- gnomAD v2.1.1 (non‑Finnish Europeans): https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/
- gnomAD v2.1.1 (Finnish Europeans): https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/

> *Note:* Allele frequencies can vary slightly between sub‑populations (e.g., Northern vs. Southern Europe) and between different reference datasets. The values above represent the most widely cited estimates from large, population‑based sequencing projects.
